name: Standard quadratic equation
rationale: Degree 2 polynomial with Delta = 1 > 0. Two real roots {2, 3} verified.

name: Rational equation with extraneous root and unsafe transfer detection
rationale: Root 2 makes denominator zero; copying {2, 3} from T1 is an UNSAFE_COPY. Only x=3 is sound.

name: Rational identity with domain exclusion preservation
rationale: Reduces to 0=0 (identity), but domain is R \ {2}. Solution is all real numbers except 2.

name: Zero-product factorization and division root-loss detection
rationale: Zero product yields {0, 1}. Unconditional division by x loses the root x=0.

name: Quadratic with a=0 degeneracy rejection
rationale: Leading coefficient a=0 rejects M2. Equation reduces to linear 2x - 4 = 0 solved by M1.

name: Biquadratic substitution with sign constraint enforcement
rationale: t = x^2 yields t=1 and t=-2. t=-2 is discarded because t >= 0. Real roots are {-1, 1}.

name: Quadratic formula with negative discriminant (empty real set)
rationale: M2 is applicable, leading coefficient a=1 != 0. Delta = -4 < 0, real solution set is empty set.

name: Out-of-scope radical equation safe rejection
rationale: Square root function sqrt() is outside DEV-01 scope; rejected safely by parser.
